key_insight: EERLoss directly approximates Equal Error Rate during training, aligning optimization with the main biometric verification metric and improving performance on keystroke dynamics.
engineering_relevance: This gives biometric system builders a task-aligned loss that can speed convergence and potentially improve real-world verification accuracy on operating points that matter.
method: Subdifferentiable, arbitrarily accurate approximation of EER for end-to-end deep model training.
Designed to be adaptable to other DET-curve operating points, not just EER.
Validated by retraining a strong keystroke-dynamics baseline with the new loss.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on the large-scale KVC-onGoing benchmark with over 185,000 subjects, where EERLoss outperformed prior losses and reduced EER by up to about 30% versus the original winning architecture.
watch_item: Because the loss is an approximation to a non-differentiable metric, its accuracy and stability may depend on the chosen approximation settings and training regime.
paper_title: EERLoss: A Novel Loss Function for Training Deep Biometric Models. A Case Study in Keystroke Dynamics
